name: getmessage-authentication
description: getMessage and getMessages (without headersOnly) return authentication (new in 0.19.0): the SPF, DKIM and DMARC results of the topmost Authentication-Results header of five seeded POP3 messages, as the receiving server wrote them, with authservId and the domain and selector each result names. A header folded over several lines with two DKIM signatures is read in full; a message with no such header has no authentication; a header that a sender wrote lower down (a forged pass) is never read, also when the topmost header holds no result (only authservId comes back); a header with no server name, comments, upper-case domains, a final dot, the domain of header.i and a selector that is not valid is cleaned (comments dropped, domains in lower case, the selector left out). Nothing is verified by Thunderbird or by the add-on: the values are what the header says. Not covered: a header over 8,192 characters, more than ten DKIM results, and the other methods a header can report (only SPF, DKIM and DMARC are read). Nothing is sent.

steps.note: Seeded mbox files have no .msf summary; running the (empty) filter list over the folder makes Thunderbird parse it.

checks.note: authservId, then SPF, both DKIM signatures (in order, with selectors) and DMARC, each with its domain.
A message without an Authentication-Results header has no authentication.
What the receiving server (the topmost header) reported: SPF and DMARC failed, no DKIM.
The header written lower down is ignored.
A topmost header with no result gives only the server name: the passes of the forged header below are not used.
No server name, so no authservId; domains in lower case without the final dot; the domain of header.i; a selector with a space is left out.
What a comment says is dropped.
The message without a header is followed at once by the next one: no authentication in its entry.
